After the death of Qutub-ud-din Aibak, **Aram Shah** ascended the throne of the Delhi Sultanate [d2][d3]. According to Wikipedia's article on Aram Shah, he reigned from December 1210 to June 1211, with Qutb ud-Din Aibak listed as his predecessor [d2]. The Wikipedia article on Qutb ud-Din Aibak confirms: "Aibak was succeeded by Aram Shah, and then by his former slave and son-in-law Iltutmish" [d3]. Aibak died unexpectedly in 1210 after falling off his horse while playing polo, and the Turkic nobles in Lahore appointed Aram Shah as his successor to prevent instability in the kingdom [d2][d4][d6]. However, Aram Shah's rule was short-lived; he was soon defeated by Iltutmish, who then became the next Sultan of Delhi [d9][d10].
